how_to: Translate each value of `items` to Thai following references/translation-rules.md. Write done_101.json with the SAME keys: {"items": {key: thai}}. List values stay lists.

items.lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.superstiti: +%1$s experience points for each additional level of Looting activated by the %2$s ability.
items.lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.anglers_ha: Has a %1$s%% chance to increase the amount of catch received. If successful, the ability repeats, adding more catch. This continues until the chance fails, summing all catches.
+%1$s experience points for each additional catch generated by the %2$s ability.
items.lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.lucky_scar: Increases Luck level when mining blocks.
Has a %1$s%% chance to apply an additional level of Luck to mined blocks. If successful, the ability repeats, adding another Luck level. This continues until the chance fails, summing all levels.
+%1$s experience points for each additional level of Luck activated by the %2$s ability.
items.lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.scarf_of_i: When moving carefully, makes the player invisible to surroundings.

Grants the player complete invisibility. The effect is lost for %1$s seconds upon any interaction with the world. If during the absence of invisibility any mob targets the player, the effect will not restore until that mob won't lose sight of the player.
+%1$s experience points for each use of the %2$s ability to become invisible.
items.lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.flame_pend: Burns anyone who dares to attack the relic bearer.
Has a %2$s%% chance to ignite the target attacking the player for %1$s seconds.
+%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.
items.lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.shock_pend: Strikes with lightning anyone who dares to attack the relic bearer.
Grants complete resistance to lightning damage.
Has a %2$s%% chance to strike the target attacking the player with lightning, dealing %1$s damage.
+%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.
items.lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.thorn_pend: Poisons anyone who dares to attack the relic bearer.
Has a %3$s%% chance to reflect %1$s%% damage and apply poison to the target attacking the player for %2$s seconds.
+%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.
items.lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.cowboy_hat: Enhances the agility of the relic bearer’s mounts.
Increases the movement speed, jump height, and safe fall height of mounts by %1$s%%.
When used, this ability allows you to ride and control any mob for up to %1$s seconds. After the time expires or dismounting, it goes on a 1-minute cooldown.
+%1$s experience points with a 25% chance for each second of riding.
+%1$s experience points for each use of the %2$s ability.
items.lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.crystal_he: Grants the relic bearer extra strength by increasing their maximum health.
Increases the player's maximum health by %1$s points.
+%1$s experience points for each instance of health regeneration. The probability of gaining experience is inversely proportional to the ratio of current health to maximum health.
items.lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.universal_: Manipulates a weak magnetic field around the relic bearer, controlling the gravity of nearby items.

A toggleable ability with 3 modes: Attraction, Repulsion, and Neutrality. In the red Attraction mode, items within a radius of %1$s blocks are drawn toward the player. In the blue Repulsion mode, items are pushed away. The purple Neutrality mode disables the relic's effect.

+%1$s experience points for each item picked up using the %2$s ability. The probability of gaining experience is directly proportional to the ratio of current item count in the stack to its maximum capacity. Does not work if the item was dropped by the relic bearer.
items.lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.cross_neck: Envelops the relic bearer in a protective aura, granting temporary invulnerability after each hit taken.
Increases the duration of invulnerability after taking damage by %1$s seconds.
+%1$s experience points for each instance of damage taken.
items.lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.night_visi: Allows the relic bearer to see more clearly in the dark.
Enhances the brightness of poorly lit areas and reduces the effectiveness of blindness and darkness by %1$s%%.

+%1$s experience points for every 5 seconds of movement in darkness. The probability of gaining experience is directly proportional to the current light level ratio at the player's location to the maximum.
items.lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.cloud_in_a: Enhances the relic bearer's agility, allowing for additional jumps in the air.
Allows up to %1$s additional air jumps.
+%1$s experience points for each additional jump performed using the %2$s ability.
items.lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.vampiric_g: Grants the relic bearer's attacks a vampiric effect, healing them by a portion of the damage dealt.
Heals the player for %1$s%% of the damage dealt.
+%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability. The probability of gaining experience is directly proportional to the ratio of healing received to the player's maximum health.
items.lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.golden_hoo: Allows the relic bearer to perform more precise attacks, retaining more experience from killed mobs.
Increases experience gained from killing mobs by %1$s%%.
+%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.
items.lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.onion_ring: Enhances the relic bearer's block mining efficiency when sufficiently satiated.
Increases block mining speed by %1$s%% per unit of the player's saturation.
When mining blocks, there is a %1$s%% chance to restore 1 hunger point and 0.5 saturation to the player.
+%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.
+%1$s experience points for each block mined. The chance of gaining experience is directly proportional to current saturation. Does not work on blocks with instant break.
items.lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.digging_cl: Strengthens the relic bearer's hands, allowing them to chop through any blocks more effectively.
Reduces the required tool level for all blocks by 1.
+%1$s experience points for each mined block. The probability of gaining experience is directly proportional to the block's toughness. Does not work on blocks with instant destruction.
items.lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.feral_claw: Awakens a bloodthirsty instinct in the relic bearer, making them fight faster with each consecutive attack.

Increases the player's attack speed by %1$s%% for each consecutive attack performed within 3 seconds of the last. Otherwise, loses 1 charge per second. Attacking with an unfilled attack speed bar resets the accumulated charges.
+%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.
items.lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.antidote_v: Enhances the relic bearer's resistance to effects.
Reduces the duration of negative effects received by %1$s%%.
Each successful attack steals %1$s seconds from all positive effects present on the target.
+%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.
+%1$s experience points for each effect stolen using the %2$s ability.
items.lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.power_glov: Allows the relic bearer to perform empowered attacks.
Increases the player's damage dealt by %1$s%% but enters a 5-second cooldown after each attack.
+%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.
items.lang|rarcompat|tooltip.relics.withered_b: Fills the relic bearer's weapon with withering energy, affecting all it touches.
Has a %1$s%% chance to apply the Wither effect to the attacked target for %2$s seconds.
Grants complete resistance to wither damage.
+%1$s experience points for each activation of the %2$s ability.
Improves the relic bearer's mobility in harsh snowy conditions.
